_about: Prosio himself: his fat, his size, what he burns, his bruises, and how his muscles and skills grow and fade.

fat._about: Prosio's fat, in kilograms. (His weight is this and the rest of him, added up from his parts.) Running out of it and of his carbs as well, or carrying too much fat, is a fail.

FAT_START.about: kg of fat he starts with

FAT_DANGER.about: warning zone width at each end

KG_START.about: what he weighs at the start; walking and running burn in proportion to this

KG_SLIM.about: the weight at which he is at his narrowest

moving._about: His size, his stamina, and how long a bump, a stoop and a jump take.

PROSIO_SIZE.about: How big Prosio is drawn, against the animals and the meadow: his body is modelled in its own measurements, and everything that comes from them (his size on the ground, where his hands and shoulders are, how long his arms are, how high he lifts and throws) is scaled by this.

STAMINA_MAX.about: the most stamina he can have, in points

DASH_TIME.about: seconds a bump carries him forward

PICK_TIME.about: stooping to pick something up and putting it in the sack

JUMP_ENERGY.about: Ordinary legs put the same energy into every jump, so height = energy / weight: a 40 kg Prosio jumps 0.9 high, a 120 kg Prosio only 0.3. Strong legs put in more (see LEG_SPRING in the skills section).

lean_to_fat._about: Everything here gets worse with fat, and the gap is deliberately wide: each pair is his value when lean (no fat) and with all the fat he can carry (FAT_MAX); in between it goes smoothly from one to the other. Strong legs and good lungs make up for some of it (see the skills section).

WALK_SPEED.about: how fast he walks, m/s (curving: most of the slowing comes early)

SPRINT_BOOST.about: how many times faster he sprints than he walks

SPRINT_DRAIN.about: stamina a second of sprinting costs

DASH_SPEED.about: how fast a bump carries him, m/s

STAMINA_REGEN.about: stamina that comes back each second (curving like the walk)

burning._about: Everything he does burns some of his weight, a little for everyday things and more for fighting. Walking and running burn in proportion to his weight: these are for an 80 kg Prosio.

LOAD_EASE.about: the share of the sack's weight his legs feel (it is on his back, well packed)

LOAD_TRAIN.about: so with 16 kg in the sack his legs train 1.36 times as fast

LOAD_HEAVY.about: a sack this share of his weight, and he says so

FIGHT_BURN.about: kg per bump, grab, bash or throw

BRUISE_FLOOR.about: A knock from an animal, or a sting, leaves a bruise: no weight is lost, but the top of his stamina comes down by that much until it mends, so a battered Prosio cannot sprint or fight for long and has to get away. The bruises never take more than BRUISE_MOST, which leaves him BRUISE_FLOOR of his stamina to run with; bruised that far, the next thing is that he is knocked out, and wakes up at home.

BRUISE_MOST.about: the most his bruises can take off the top of his stamina, in points (worked out from BRUISE_FLOOR)

BRUISE.about: stamina points a knock from each kind bruises off, before his fat and hide soften it

BRUISE_MEND.about: points a second, times 0.5 (lacking protein and vitamins) to 2 (plenty of both)

BRUISE_REST.about: seconds after a knock before they start to mend

BRUISE_WARN.about: from this share of the most, he says so

muscle._about: A trait's level is 0 when ordinary and 1 at the most it can be; a muscle can go below 0, down to -1, when it has wasted away.

ARMS_KG.about: His muscles, in kg: wasted away, ordinary, and the most they can be.

LEGS_KG.about: his leg muscles, in kg, likewise

FADE.about: the share of a trait lost every second it is not used: half in 18 minutes

WASTE.about: how fast muscle wastes each second without protein, or starving: ordinary to wasted in 11 minutes

RECOVER.about: and how fast wasted muscle comes back to ordinary once he is fed

BULK.about: full of protein, muscle builds this much faster

BASAL.about: kg of energy each kg of muscle burns every second: 0.18 kg a minute for ordinary muscle, 0.41 at the most, 0.11 wasted

training._about: How much each thing he does trains (a trait gains this share of what it still lacks).

CARRY_WORK.about: arms: each second of holding something of his own weight

SWING_WORK.about: arms: each bash or throw of something of his own weight

SPRINT_WORK.about: legs and lungs: each second of sprinting

DRAG_WORK.about: legs: each second of dragging a body

GUT_WORK.about: gut: each kg of fibre eaten

FISH_WORK.about: hooves: each grab for a fish

COOK_WORK.about: baking, grilling, dairy: each thing made (half way after 11, nearly all after 50)

skills._about: What each trait is worth at its most (and a muscle at its worst).

STRONG.about: arms: how much more he lifts and how much harder he throws,

LEG_SPEED.about: legs: how much faster he walks and runs,

LEG_SPRING.about: and how much more goes into a jump;

LUNG_DRAIN.about: lungs: the share of the usual stamina a sprint costs,

LUNG_REGEN.about: and how much faster it comes back

THIN_SKIN.about: the share of a knock he feels with no fat on him,

PADDED.about: with all the fat he can carry,

TOUGH_HIDE.about: and, on top of that, with the toughest hide

GUT_CONTROL.about: gut: from this level he holds his wind until G is pressed,

GUT_HOLD.about: seconds between two of them then,

GUT_REACH.about: and how much further his wind reaches at the most

DEFT_PICK.about: hooves: the share of the usual time picking takes,

DEFT_REACH.about: and how much further he reaches for a fish or a leg

COOK_QUICK.about: baking, grilling, dairy: the share of the usual time it takes at the most (the calories are in COOK_RANGE in food.json, making)

WAKE_FAT.about: Waking up at home after the game was over: his fat is brought back inside these, he has lost this share of the muscle he had built, and his sack is gone. What he has learnt stays.

WAKE_MUSCLE_LOSS.about: the share of his built-up muscle he has lost when he wakes up at home

shape._about: His shape, in his body's own measurements. Prosio is short and stocky: short legs, a compact body and a big head.

EAR_DROOP.about: how far his ears hang over, in radians from straight up: almost straight down

LEG_SCALE.about: leg length, as a share of the old, longer legs

TORSO_SCALE.about: the body from hips to neck, likewise

HIP.about: hip height in the body's own measurements

HEAD_HEIGHT.about: the middle of his head, above his feet

character_render._about: Visual pose adjustments for the modeled Prosio.

PROSIO_MESH_OUTLINE_BIAS.about: depth offset that keeps the expanded outline behind his painted skin at tight folds

PROSIO_MESH_BLINK.about: blink interval and duration in seconds

PROSIO_MESH_BELLY.about: reference fatness, scale change per unit of fatness and wobble scale

PROSIO_MESH_POSE.about: chest twist, head countertwist and head tilt when picking up an item

PROSIO_MESH_MUNCH.about: eating head bob frequency and amplitude

PROSIO_MESH_ARM_SWING.about: upper-arm swing, shoulder clearance as the belly widens, and elbow bend

PROSIO_MESH_ELBOW_POLE.about: sideways and forward bias when bending an elbow to reach a held object

PROSIO_MESH_STRIDE.about: hip swing, shin bend and hoof counterrotation while walking

PROSIO_MESH_JUMP.about: hip tuck, offset between sides, and shin bend in the air

PROSIO_MEAL_EAT_TIME.about: time occupied by taking a bite

PROSIO_MEAL_VISUAL.about: meal kg for full belly morph, seconds holding its size, and decay rate after the hold

PROSIO_MEAL_EASE.about: rate at which the belly approaches its current target

PROSIO_REACTION_TIME.about: seconds of wind recoil, hiccup recoil and tipsy preview

PROSIO_REACTION_SWAY.about: tipsy sway frequency, its tilt, and the recovery lean for hiccups

PROSIO_REACTION_WIND.about: pitch, hip roll and free-arm bracing when he passes wind

PROSIO_REACTION_ARMS.about: arm spreading in a stagger, elbow tuck in a hiccup and hand lift in a hiccup

PROSIO_MEAL_DRAW.about: forward, sideways and vertical fullness of the procedural belly

PROSIO_MEAL_CHEW.about: remaining share of bite time at swallowing and number of chew cycles

PROSIO_FACE_RECOIL.about: hiccup chest tilt, hiccup head tilt and head lag during a stagger

PROSIO_FACE_WIND.about: belly swell, cheek puff and eyelid closure when he passes wind

PROSIO_FACE_TIPSY.about: jaw opening, smile and eyelid droop when tipsy

PROSIO_FACE_BROWS.about: brow lift while smiling, hiccuping or passing wind

PROSIO_FACE_PANT.about: panting frequency, jaw opening and amplitude

PROSIO_FACE_SMILE_FADE.about: how quickly the meal smile fades near the end of the hold

PROSIO_TIPSY_FADE.about: relative speed of the tipsy pose ramp-in and fade-out

base_sculpt._about: The base mesh anchors shared by the Odin pose and the editable Blender asset.

PROSIO_BASE_OUTLINE.about: silhouette width multiplier and depth bias to keep the hull behind tight folds

PROSIO_BASE_HEAD_LIFT.about: height of the raised head above the old face pivot

PROSIO_BASE_HEAD_RADII.about: fixed half-width, half-height and depth of the skull

PROSIO_BASE_HEAD_SCALE.about: proportion of the head, ears and face relative to the body

PROSIO_BASE_FACE_FAT.about: neutral fat kg, kg from neutral to full cheeks, and maximum lean reduction

PROSIO_BASE_ARM_LENGTHS.about: lengths from shoulder to elbow and elbow to palm in the unscaled rig

PROSIO_BASE_ARM_BIAS.about: outward elbow bias when the palm reaches around the body

PROSIO_BASE_ARM_AXIAL.about: fixed vertical half-lengths of the shoulder, biceps and elbow flesh

PROSIO_BASE_KNEE_AXIAL.about: fixed vertical half-length of the knee flesh

PROSIO_BASE_NECK_RADII.about: neck radii between the shoulders and jaw

PROSIO_BASE_NECK_ANCHOR.about: height below face, share of head bob and neck depth

PROSIO_BASE_EAR_ANCHOR.about: sideways share of cheek width, elevation and depth of the ear hinge

PROSIO_BASE_EAR_RADII.about: half-width, length and thickness of the sculpted ear

PROSIO_BASE_EAR_FOLD.about: resting fold angle, forward pitch and height over which the ears ease into the jump response

PROSIO_BASE_EAR_CENTER.about: distance from ear hinge to center of the flap

PROSIO_BASE_EAR_AIR.about: jump fold, sensitivity to vertical velocity and minimum fold angle

PROSIO_BASE_SNOUT_RADII.about: radii of the recessed nose plate

PROSIO_BASE_BROW_ANCHOR.about: brow anchor in the head frame

PROSIO_BASE_BROW_MOTION.about: lift, retreat along the forehead and tilt per unit of expression

PROSIO_BASE_BROW_TURN.about: curve around the forehead, resting arch and contribution of emotional tilt to lift

PROSIO_BASE_PEC_MASS.about: reference mass in kg and mass range over which the pec definition softens

PROSIO_BASE_PEC_ANCHOR.about: relative horizontal, vertical and depth placement on the chest

PROSIO_BASE_PEC_RADII.about: width share of the chest, half-height and frontal thickness

PROSIO_BASE_PEC_MOTION.about: relative vertical softening, depth softening and extra training definition

PROSIO_BASE_HAND_RADII.about: palm width and depth relative to arm radius, and its constant half-height

PROSIO_BASE_EYE_ANCHOR.about: center of the eye in the head frame

PROSIO_BASE_EYE_RADII.about: width, height and depth of the glossy black eye

PROSIO_BASE_LID_AT.about: closed eyelid position in the eye frame

PROSIO_BASE_MOUTH.about: half-width, center height and depth of the smile

PROSIO_BASE_SMILE_ARC.about: resting rise, expressive lift, and depth adjustment at the mouth corners

PROSIO_BASE_SMILE_TILT.about: resting and expressive smile segment angles

PROSIO_BASE_OPEN_MOUTH.about: shape of the mouth when open
